final: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price FROM rating_stats) SELECT rating_stats.rating, rating_stats.avg_replacement_cost, rating_stats.per_day_price, rating_stats.per_day_price / overall.mean_per_day_price AS relative_to_mean FROM rating_stats CROSS JOIN overall
